\chapter{Design of the registry}\label{chap:design}
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------

The issuer publishes a summary $S_t$ of the revoked identifiers, and a credential $c$ is valid at
time $t$ when $\revoked(c, S_t)$ is false. \Cref{fig:flow} shows who reads the summary.

\begin{figure}[!ht]
  \centering
  \input{figures/flow}
  \caption{The issuer writes the summary; the verifier reads it.}
  \label{fig:flow}
\end{figure}
